intro: From April to June 2026, ZCyberNews covered 52 ransomware articles, with The Gentlemen, LockBit, and ShinyHunters among the most frequently observed threat actors. Critical vulnerabilities including CVE-2026-1731 (CVSS 9.8), CVE-2026-34197 (CVSS 8.8), CVE-2024-55591, CVE-2025-32433, and CVE-2025-33073 were highlighted across reports. The healthcare, manufacturing, education, and technology sectors faced significant impacts, with incidents reported globally across North America, the United States, Europe, and Turkey. The severity mix comprised 40 high, 6 critical, 1 medium, and 2 informational entries.
